caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a chest of drawers with a writing desk and an upper cabinet. The furniture is composed mainly of reddish-brown wood with detailed grains and a glossy appearance. The lower section consists of four large horizontal drawers, each featuring two round handles made of what appears to be metal. The edges of the drawers have a lighter wood inlay as an accent. Rising above the chest, there is a slant-top writing desk that forms an inclined surface. Above this desk, the upper structure contains a central compartment with a small hinged door, flanked by two roll-top doors on each side; above these are three small drawers, each equipped with a round pull-knob. The sides and trim of the cabinet and desk are also accentuated with lighter wood borders. The furniture stands on short, curved legs and has a decorative scalloped apron at the bottom. The drawing is rendered in color pencil or watercolor on a neutral, light beige background, enclosed in a single line frame.
title: Tambour Desk
